title: Acceptance gate: delegate-grok check expects a shell command, but test delegations are now read-only
body: Build 45's gate (scripts/release/acceptance.sh) failed `delegate-grok` on every run: Grok Build started in the project and finished, but the check requires it to run a shell command. Since feb4bc8270 a test delegation is a read-only question, so Grok uses its own list/read tools. Update the check to accept any tool call (or a read of the project) as evidence that Grok worked in the project, keeping the rest of the assertion. Test against a recorded Grok event stream.
